deadline.value: January 9 for Fall entry based on the published Fall 2026 College of Engineering PhD application deadline (Fall 2027 dates not yet posted).
deadline.quote: Fall 2026 Start Term | Jan. 9, 2026: Fall 2026 application deadline

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty advisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog does not describe PhD funding or assistantships.

entry_route.value: Applicants may hold a master's in engineering or only a bachelor's in engineering; bachelor's entrants take 24 more graduate credits.
entry_route.quote: Applicants with only a bachelor’s degree in engineering may also apply. If admitted, B.S. only students must complete an additional 24 credits of graduate coursework to complete the PhD program.

app_fee.value: No application fee is charged for any College of Engineering graduate program.
app_fee.quote: The College of Engineering has removed the $50.00 application fee. There is no longer an application fee for any College of Engineering graduate program.

gre_general.value: The college does not require GRE scores but will consider them if submitted.
gre_general.quote: The College of Engineering does not require the submission of GRE scores, but we will consider your GRE scores as part of the application review if submitted.

toefl_min.value: A TOEFL score of at least 90 is expected for international applicants, with a mandatory ESL course.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL - Score of at least 90 for international applicants is expected with mandatory ESL course.

ielts_min.value: An IELTS score of at least 7.0 is expected for international applicants, with a mandatory ESL course.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS - Score of at least 7.0 for international applicants is expected with mandatory ESL course.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL or IELTS is waived if the applicant holds a U.S. degree, is a U.S. Permanent Resident, or submits an institutional letter confirming English was the primary language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: Official TOEFL or IELTS Scores sent directly from testing centers. Waived if applicant has a degree from a college/university in the U.S. or is a Permanent Resident of the U.S. If your bachelor’s or master’s degree is from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction, please provide a letter from your educational institution stating that your education was in English to have this requirement waived.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged for College of Engineering graduate programs.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no longer an application fee for any College of Engineering graduate program.

notes: One Engineering Ph.D. covers both BS-to-PhD and MS-to-PhD entry, with a concentration in any College of Engineering program. The catalog's graduate programs in chemical/biochemical, civil/water resources and environmental, electrical/computer, mechanical/aerospace and biomedical engineering are listed as also_fields. Sustainable Engineering and Cybersecurity are not mapped to a field because the catalog names no department for them. The PhD deadline, zero application fee, and English-medium waiver come from the College of Engineering PhD Program Application Requirements page; funding and supervisor approval before admission are not stated there or in the catalog.
name: Engineering, Ph.D.
